name: comp_revision_flow_leaders_2026-09-25
strategy: Bet on the strongest 90-day analyst revision flow, not on target-level upside: 24 names where net target raises came from at least three distinct firms, concentrated in software (OKTA, SNOW, CRWD, PANW, CRM, GTLB, ESTC, NET, DDOG, WDAY, S, DT, ZS, MDB), large-cap pharma (MRK, ABBV, AMGN, LLY, ARGX), semis (NVDA, AMD, ASML, TSM) and AME. Every name has a Q3 print or PDUFA inside the Oct 12-Nov 13 window, so relative P&L is driven by real events. I would be wrong if the revision flow was already fully priced and the prints sell off on beats, or if a single AI-capex digestion headline hits the correlated software/semis sleeve at once.
